title: Omega(n log n) Boolean Circuit Lower Bound for Integer Multiplication
exact_target: Must every Boolean circuit that multiplies two n-bit integers use at least a constant times n log n gates, even with unrestricted depth and wiring?

sources.citation: P. Afshani, C. B. Freksen, L. Kamma and K. G. Larsen, Lower Bounds for Multiplication via Network Coding, ICALP 2019, 10:1–10:12.
